final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT r.ordervault, o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY r.ordervault, o.timespan), step2 AS (SELECT timespan, SUM(record_count) AS group_count FROM step1 GROUP BY timespan), step3 AS (SELECT SUM(group_count) AS total_count FROM step2), step4 AS (SELECT s.timespan, s.group_count, 1.0 * s.group_count / t.total_count AS ratio FROM step2 AS s CROSS JOIN step3 AS t), step5 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio FROM step4) SELECT s.timespan, s.group_count, s.ratio, s.ratio - a.average_ratio AS deviation FROM step4 AS s CROSS JOIN step5 AS a
